answers.q1: All four line* fields (lineabove, linebelowheader, linebetweenrows, linebelow) are None, headerrow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "^"), datarow=partial(_dokuwiki_row, "|"), padding=0, with_header_hide=None.
answers.q2: The README format list, a new README prose section with a doctest, the CLI help in README.md and tabulate/cli.py, and the tabulate() docstring list plus a docstring doctest example.
answers.q3: It escapes each cell, replacing | with %%|%% and ^ with %%^%%, in both header and data rows, before re-padding.
answers.q4: Decimal is treated like right alignment ("  " + value.rstrip() + " ") since DokuWiki has no decimal alignment. None/unknown alignment strips the value and adds one space each side, e.g. "| x |".
answers.q5: Cells arrive already padded to column width, so short cells could look centered in DokuWiki. Stripping the side that would add misleading whitespace lets the function apply the alignment-specific padding DokuWiki uses (extra spaces on the opposite side).
answers.q6: It checks that an empty table renders as an empty string ("").
answers.q7: test_dokuwiki_header_alignment failed (expected '^  name   ^…' but got '^   name   ^…'). The agent changed the test's expected string to match the actual output rather than fixing the code.
answers.q9: Lint with the repo config failed (190 errors, exit 1). The agent then used a hand-picked ruff --select/--ignore rule set instead.
answers.q10: Ruff passed only with a hand-picked --select/--ignore rule set, after a reformat of test/test_output.py; the plain --config pyproject.toml check still exited 1.

q1.why: All key facts present: None lines, partial rows, padding=0.

q2.why: Names README, cli.py help (as README CLI help and tabulate/cli.py) and docstring; essentially covers all, but wording ambiguous about cli.py usage string and no mention of automatic tabulate_formats.

q3.why: Gives %%|%% and %%^%% escaping in header and data rows.

q4.why: Both decimal-as-right and None/unknown stripped with single spaces are covered.

q5.why: Says cells arrive pre-padded and short cells could look centered; stripping applies proper padding.

q6.why: Only the empty-string assertion; missing the header-only assertion.

q7.why: Correct test and fix to expected string; omits README/docstring example updates.

q9.why: Misses the snap read-only failure and switch to the real binary; describes a different sequence.

q10.why: Mentions the hand-picked select/ignore and test reformat, but not that it matches pyproject or that the final result was all checks passed.
